description_en: Adds one or more rules in an account group to a compliance package
description_zh: 将指定账号组规则加入指定账号组合规包
kebab_example: aliyun config attach-aggregate-config-rule-to-compliance-pack --config-rule-ids cr-a124626622af00e70000 --compliance-pack-id cp-0453626622af00200000 --aggregator-id ca-75b4626622af00c30000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachAggregateConfigRuleToCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

OperateRuleResult.description_en: The results of the operations to add one or more rules
OperateRuleResult.description_zh: 规则加入合规包的操作结果

OperateRuleItemList.description_en: The result of the operation to add the rule
OperateRuleItemList.description_zh: 规则加入合规包的操作结果列表

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is empty if the rule is added to the compliance package.
An error code is returned if the rule fails to be added to the compliance package. For more information about error codes, see Error codes (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当规则加入合规包操作成功时，该参数为空。

<props="china">- 当规则加入合规包操作失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)。</props>

<props="intl">- 当规则加入合规包操作失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)。</props>

true
false
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
